cover.sub: Teach with a brand, run your own, or both

title: Pick by *how you want to teach*
verdict.sub: There is no single best path. Start from what you want next.

rows.need: You want your own batches, fees and student list
rows.why: AllCoaching: own domain and Android + iOS app on every plan, 14-day free trial

rows.need: You want students found for you in set hours
rows.why: Its teacher page asks for 3+ hours a day between 4 and 10 PM IST

rows.need: You want steady hours and a batch of your own
rows.why: Teach with a brand and run one batch on the side, if your agreement allows

rows.need: You teach a handful of home students
rows.why: WhatsApp and UPI work for a few students; move to one login as you grow

title: Start *with one batch*
switch.sub: No need to give anything up first
steps: Schedule, notes, a test and your fee

checks: Tests and notes in one place
